narration.en: The moment fear stops you, you've already lost.
narration.zh-cn: 恐惧让你停下的瞬间， 你就已经输了。
narration.fr: L'instant où la peur t'arrête, tu as déjà perdu.

narration.ko: 한 거북이가 높은 산을 오르기로 했어. 모두가 미쳤다고 했지만, 꼭대기에서 보는 풍경이 궁금했거든.
narration.en: A turtle decided to climb a high mountain. Everyone said it was crazy, but it was curious about the view from the top.
narration.zh-cn: 一只乌龟决定爬一座高山。大家都说它疯了，但它好奇山顶的风景。
narration.fr: Une tortue décida d'escalader une haute montagne. Tous la trouvaient folle, mais elle était curieuse de la vue au sommet.

narration.ko: 첫 시도는 실패였어. 비에 젖은 바위에 미끄러져 굴러떨어졌지. 다리가 아프고, 자신감도 바닥이었어.
narration.en: The first attempt failed. It slipped on a wet rock and tumbled down. Its legs hurt, and its confidence hit rock bottom.
narration.zh-cn: 第一次尝试失败了。它在湿滑的岩石上滑倒滚落。腿疼，自信心也跌到谷底。
narration.fr: La première tentative échoua. Elle glissa sur une roche mouillée et dégringola. Ses pattes lui faisaient mal, et sa confiance était au plus bas.

narration.ko: 그때 부엉이 할아버지가 말했어. '거북아, 산은 한 번에 오르는 게 아니란다. 한 걸음씩, 우직하게.'
narration.en: Then Grandpa Owl said, 'Little turtle, you don't climb a mountain all at once. One step at a time, stubbornly.'
narration.zh-cn: 这时猫头鹰爷爷说：'小乌龟，山不是一口气爬上去的。一步一步，笨拙地坚持。'
narration.fr: Alors Grand-Père Hibou dit : 'Petite tortue, on ne gravit pas une montagne d'un coup. Un pas à la fois, obstinément.'

subtitle.en: One step at a time, stubbornly
subtitle.fr: Un pas à la fois, obstinément

narration.ko: 거북이는 다시 일어났어. 매일 조금씩, 아주 느리게. 다른 동물들이 지나쳐도 괜찮았어. 자기만의 속도로 올랐거든.
narration.en: The turtle got up again. A little every day, very slowly. It was okay when other animals passed by. It climbed at its own pace.
narration.zh-cn: 乌龟再次站了起来。每天一点点，非常缓慢。其他动物超过它也没关系。它按自己的速度爬。
narration.fr: La tortue se releva. Un peu chaque jour, très lentement. Ce n'était pas grave si d'autres animaux la dépassaient. Elle grimpait à son propre rythme.

scenes.image_prompt: children's storybook watercolor illustration, soft warm muted colors, a small green turtle with a tiny blue backpack, The small turtle finally reaching the mountain summit, standing proudly on a flat rock, arms raised, a breathtaking panoramic view of clouds and distant peaks, golden sunset, triumphant moment, gentle atmospheric light, cozy detailed background, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logo

narration.ko: 마침내 정상에 섰어. 그 풍경은 상상 이상이었어. 우직하게 한 걸음씩 걸었기에 여기까지 온 거야.
narration.en: Finally, it stood at the summit. The view was beyond imagination. It had come this far by taking one stubborn step at a time.
narration.zh-cn: 终于，它站在了山顶。那风景超乎想象。正是笨拙地一步一步走，才走到了这里。
narration.fr: Enfin, elle se tenait au sommet. La vue dépassait l'imagination. Elle était arrivée là en faisant un pas obstiné après l'autre.

narration.ko: 우리도 마찬가지야. 새로운 일, 공부, 관계. 시작이 두렵고 실패가 무서워서 멈추고 싶을 때가 많지.
narration.en: It's the same for us. New jobs, studies, relationships. We often want to stop because starting is scary and failure is frightening.
narration.zh-cn: 我们也一样。新工作、学习、关系。开始很可怕，失败很吓人，我们常常想停下。
narration.fr: C'est pareil pour nous. Nouveau travail, études, relations. On veut souvent arrêter parce que commencer fait peur et l'échec effraie.

subtitle.en: Starting is scary, failure is frightening
subtitle.zh-cn: 开始很可怕，失败很吓人

narration.ko: 하지만 기억해. 완벽해서 시작하는 게 아니야. 시작했기에 완벽해지는 거야. 오늘, 딱 한 걸음만 내디뎌 봐.
narration.en: But remember. You don't start because you're perfect. You become perfect because you started. Today, just take one step.
narration.zh-cn: 但记住。你不是因为完美才开始。而是因为开始了才变得完美。今天，就迈出一步吧。
narration.fr: Mais souviens-toi. On ne commence pas parce qu'on est parfait. On devient parfait parce qu'on a commencé. Aujourd'hui, fais juste un pas.
